# HomeTriangle

> > HomeTriangle connects homeowners with vetted service professionals across major Indian cities for home maintenance, repairs, and improvement services.

HomeTriangle operates as India's leading home services marketplace, offering handyman services, appliance repair, cleaning, pest control, and painting across cities like Bangalore, Mysore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, and more. The platform also publishes lifestyle content on health, fitness, home improvement, and sustainability.
